product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Double-Layer Metal Frame Hanging Wall Mirror, 30 Inch Height, Brass Finish
product.description: Look closely, and you'll notice the double-layered frame that adds depth and texture to this mirror, while the brass finish gives it a vintage look. This mirror will blend with classic and transitional styles in a bedroom, hallway or living room. Modern design with antique-look finish Glass, iron frame with brass finish 18.25"W x 3"D x 30"H Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
